caption:
Made a mistake you regret? Your Lord has answered

Allah has decreed mercy upon Himself. Whoever commits a sin out of ignorance, then repents and mends his ways, will find Allah All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

Surah Al-An'aam 6:54

Turn back to Him tonight before you sleep.

#repentance #tawbah #surahanam #allahsmercy

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: When those who believe in Our verses come to you, say, “Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed mercy upon Himself; whoever among you commits a sin out of ignorance then repents afterwards and mends his ways, then Allah is indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.” (Surah Al-An'aam 6:54)
theme: repentance / your Lord has decreed mercy upon Himself
